title: Bug triage
description: Takes a bug report (title, body, reporter), flags urgent ones by keyword, and has Claude suggest likely causes and first checks for those. Appends every report to triage/bugs.md. Press Run to see a sample, or add a webhook under ⋯ > Triggers and POST your report to it as JSON. Needs an Anthropic API key saved as a credential named "anthropic" (⋯ > Credentials) (only for urgent reports).
name: Bug triage

config.system: You are a careful senior engineer triaging a bug report.

config.source:
def main(input_data):
    return {"text": "Routine: no urgent signals. Queue for the normal backlog."}

from datetime import datetime


def main(input_data):
    r = input_data["report"]
    analysis = (input_data.get("analyze") or input_data.get("routine"))["text"]
    flag = "URGENT" if r["urgent"] else "routine"
    stamp = datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    text = "## %s [%s] %s\nReported by %s\n\n%s\n\n---\n\n" % (
        stamp, flag, r["title"], r["reporter"], analysis.strip())
    return {"text": text}
